shortDescription: Manage NFS aliases on a PowerScale Storage System

options.name: access_zone
options.description: Specifies the zone in which the alias is valid. Access zone once set cannot be changed.

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: check
options.description: Check for conflicts when viewing alias.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: path
options.description: Specifies the path to which the alias points. It is the absolute path for System access zone and it is relative if using non-system access zone. If your access zone is System, and you have 'directory1' in the access zone, the path provided should be '/ifs/directory1'. The directory on the path must exist, the NFS alias module will not create the directory.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: scope
options.description: When specified as C(effective), or not specified, all fields are returned. When specified as C(user), only fields with non-default values are shown.

options.name: state
options.description: Defines whether the NFS alias should exist or not. C(present) indicates that the NFS alias should exist in system. C(absent) indicates that the NFS alias should not exist in system.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
